_comment: Settings of the three Railway services. Not read by Railway: Config as Code is deprecated and new services cannot use it. scripts/deploy.mjs sends dockerfilePath, drainingSeconds, overlapSeconds and healthcheckTimeout as the service variables Railway reads (RAILWAY_DOCKERFILE_PATH, RAILWAY_DEPLOYMENT_DRAINING_SECONDS, RAILWAY_DEPLOYMENT_OVERLAP_SECONDS, RAILWAY_HEALTHCHECK_TIMEOUT_SEC, D283); the rest (region, start and pre-deploy command, pre-deploy timeout, replicas, health path, restart policy, memory) is entered in the dashboard. Key names follow the former railway.json deploy section; memory is in bytes. The adapter test checks these values.

api.preDeployCommand: sh -c 'node dist/init-bucket.js && node dist/migrate.js && node dist/seed.js'
